title: UE requested PDN disconnection procedure accepted by the network

entities.name: UE requested PDN disconnection procedure accepted by the network
entities.description: Procedure where the network accepts the UE's PDN disconnection request and initiates bearer context deactivation.

entities.name: PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request PDN disconnection.

entities.name: DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by MME to initiate bearer context deactivation.

entities.name: DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by UE to accept bearer context deactivation.

entities.name: Linked EPS bearer identity
entities.description: IE identifying the default bearer associated with the PDN to disconnect.

entities.name: Procedure transaction identity
entities.description: IE used to identify the procedure transaction.

entities.name: T3492
entities.description: Timer used in PDN disconnection procedure.

entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
entities.description: State entered by UE after stopping timer T3492.

entities.name: MME releases PDN resources
entities.description: MME releases all resources reserved for the PDN upon receiving DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT.

relations.description: Procedure starts upon receipt of PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST message.
MME initiates bearer context deactivation by sending DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST.
DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST contains linked EPS bearer identity IE.
DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST contains PTI IE.
UE stops timer T3492 upon receiving DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST with matching PTI.
UE enters PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE state after stopping T3492.
MME releases PDN resources upon receiving DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT.
